newsitem.title: USA: Northwest to open three new branches.
newsitem.headline: Northwest to open three new branches.

text.p: Northwest Savings Bank said Thursday it will open three new bank offices in in the near future in Lititz, Lancaster County and Hanover and Springettsbury Township, both in York County.
The bank said it expects all three new offices to be full-service banks that will complement Northwest's five existing offices in York and Lancaster Counties.
Founded in 1896, Northwest Savings Bank holds assets of $1.96 billion and operates fifty-five community banking offices in sixteen counties in western and central Pennsylvania.
